fields.name: work_id
fields.description: Canonical identifier for the translation work. Joins to editions.work_id.

fields.name: display_name
fields.description: Curated short display name for the work, in the work's source language when applicable.

fields.name: edition_id
fields.description: Canonical identifier for a specific edition or revision. Joins to instances.edition_id.

fields.name: display_name
fields.description: Curated short edition label shown to users, such as a year, revision name, or edition number.

fields.name: publication_year
fields.description: text_date as a plain year (interval end, uncertainty dropped); the sort and plot key.

fields.name: text_date
fields.description: EDTF date of this text state ('1975', uncertain '2016?', interval '1995/2016'); see docs/targum-corpus/text-dating.md.

fields.name: dating_base
fields.description: EDTF date of the older text this edition reworks, when its wording is much older than text_date; empty otherwise.

fields.name: dating_update_kinds
fields.description: Kinds of change made by this edition's update (orthographic_modernization, language_modernization, translation_revision, ...).

fields.name: dating_update_note
fields.description: What the update changed, the evidence for its date, and the uncertainty.

fields.name: copyright_status
fields.description: Curated edition-level copyright status used by viewer summaries and access notices.

fields.name: copyright_statement
fields.description: Verbatim copyright or license statement for this edition, when available.

fields.name: copyright_statement_source_url
fields.description: URL where the verbatim statement was observed.

fields.name: license
fields.description: SPDX license identifier or project-local LicenseRef value, when applicable.

fields.name: rights_holder
fields.description: Person or organization holding rights, when applicable.

fields.name: site
fields.description: Source site from which this translation instance was scraped.

fields.name: iso
fields.description: ISO 639-3 language code for the instance.

fields.name: instance_id
fields.description: Site-specific translation identifier.

fields.name: instance_name
fields.description: Site-declared translation name, preserved as scraped/source metadata.

fields.name: instance_abbr
fields.description: Site-declared abbreviation, when available.

fields.name: edition_id
fields.description: Canonical edition identifier this source instance is bound to; joins to editions.edition_id.

fields.name: work_id
fields.description: Canonical work identifier derived from the edition binding; joins to works.work_id.

fields.name: num_books
fields.description: Number of New Testament books with at least one verse in this instance corpus.

fields.name: num_chapters
fields.description: Number of New Testament book-chapter pairs with at least one verse in this instance corpus.

fields.name: num_verses
fields.description: Number of verse records in this instance corpus.

fields.name: num_words
fields.description: Approximate whitespace-tokenized word count for this instance corpus.

fields.name: text_included
fields.description: Whether verse text for this instance is included in this export tier.

fields.name: completeness_status
fields.description: Curator acknowledgment of less-than-27-book coverage: partial_by_design (the edition never was a full NT), partial_at_source (the site does not serve the missing books), partial_extraction_gap (our crawl lost text the site serves), partial_unverified (recorded, not yet checked). Empty when coverage is complete.

fields.name: completeness_note
fields.description: Curator note explaining why books are missing; carries any supporting detail such as which books or the page attesting the gap.

fields.name: completeness_checked_at
fields.description: ISO date the gap was recorded or checked against the source site.
